verdict.rationale: Riskified is an ML-driven fraud-detection SaaS, so whether a customer can stop their data from training models is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence pack documents no opt-out, data-use control, or training-exclusion setting. The only related mention (onboarding where the analytics team is 'calibrating the models' on merchant data) describes data being used for models, not a way to prevent it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
